info.description:
The subject introduces vocabulary for standard spoken language, live and broadcast, on both familiar and unfamiliar topics. There are many lectures, 
talks, reports and other forms of academic/professional presentations that are propositionally and linguistically complex.
Learners will practice 
the

skills needed for listening

including previewing, scanning, skimming for general ideas, making inferences, recognizing the sequence of events, identifying the relationship between main ideas and details, predicting the content, realizing the events in chronology, formulating pre-listening questions about the topics, relating examples to the main ideas, recognizing appositives that explain, organizing notes with a T-chart, realizing problems and solution, understanding the overall structure of a passage, recognizing organizational cues, using tables to organize note-taking, recognizing meaning conveyed by intonation patterns, associating ideas with different speakers, understanding pros and cons, the impact of word stress on meaning of words.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand key words, structures and main content in the listening text
Apply a variety of listening skills in completing listening tasks and daily communication.
Analyze contents and structures of intermediate/upper-intermediate level listening texts to understand the speaker’s opinions.
